pages.title: A new account · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in downtown Dallas. Caio walks into a large bank with a folder. Inside the folder are his passport and a bill. He is new in the city and needs a bank account. A woman at the desk smiles at him. Her name tag says Beth.
“Good morning! How can I help you today?” says Beth. “I want to open a checking account.” says Caio. “Great. Do you have an ID and a proof of address?” says Beth.
